title: Atlas rc2 handoff
body: Atlas stopped at release candidate rc2. The Windows package failed signing because the generated manifest omitted the publisher field. Do not promote rc2; after the manifest fix, rerun the Windows package smoke before tagging.

title: commit 9f31: restore Windows publisher
body: Commit 9f31 adds the publisher field to the generated Windows manifest. Next safe action: rerun the package smoke and verify the signed artifact before creating a release tag.

title: Outbound action safety decision
body: Every outbound action must show a dry-run preview and receive explicit approval before execution. Reading and drafting may be automatic; the execute transition may not be inferred from earlier consent.

title: commit 61ac: action execution gate
body: Added the approval check in src/control/action_gate.py. The executor refuses any action whose preview id has no matching approval record.

title: Retrieval experiment decision
body: Vector-only retrieval missed rare identifiers and exact error codes. On the frozen 50-case set it found all required evidence in 21 percent of cases, so we chose lexical-plus-vector hybrid retrieval.

title: commit a512: hybrid retrieval
body: Hybrid rank fusion increased complete evidence retrieval from 21 percent to 38 percent on the same 50 cases. Median latency rose by 12 milliseconds.

title: Northstar positioning decision
body: Position Northstar as an evidence layer for agents, not a second brain. I rejected the claim that it replaces human memory; the useful promise is that agent answers can be traced back to sources.

title: Northstar product brief
body: Approved positioning: a private evidence layer that gives agents source-addressed context. Do not claim memory replacement, mind uploading, or perfect recall.

title: issue 184: large export timeout
body: Three users reported that exports above 10,000 records timed out after four minutes. Issue #184 requests streaming output and visible progress.

title: commit c820: stream export chunks
body: Rewrote export to stream 500-record chunks. The 10,000-record fixture fell from a four-minute timeout to 38 seconds and peak memory fell by 71 percent.

title: Account key migration plan
body: Migration 0042 adds the account_key column. Before activation, backfill every existing row, verify zero duplicate keys, and preserve a rollback snapshot.

title: commit d042: account key schema
body: Migration 0042 and dual-write are complete. Historical backfill and duplicate verification remain pending; activation stays disabled.

title: Parser launch cleanup
body: I deferred removal of the v2 compatibility shim so the parser could launch. Remove it only after v3-format traffic exceeds 95 percent for a full week.

title: Parser debt trigger
body: Debt item P-17: delete the compatibility shim after the v3 share remains above 95 percent for seven days; until then, keep its regression test.

title: General roadmap
body: The roadmap lists possible dashboard polish and documentation work but records no release blocker, decision, deadline, or measured outcome.

title: Meridian failed deploy investigation
body: The first two Meridian deploys failed because the container health check called 127.0.0.1 while the service listened on 0.0.0.0. The container was healthy internally but the probe never reached the bound port.

title: commit b72e: align Meridian health check
body: Commit b72e changed the health-check target to the service port on 0.0.0.0 and added a container smoke test. The third deploy succeeded.

title: Risky review format preference
body: For risky pull requests, lead with the failure mode and rollback path. Then show proof from focused tests. Keep the prose summary short; attach screenshots only when behavior is visual.

title: Pull request review checklist
body: Risky change review order: failure mode, rollback, focused test evidence, concise summary. Include a screenshot for user-visible changes; do not use screenshots as proof for nonvisual behavior.

title: Relay v1 scope decision
body: Relay v1 is local-folder sync on one device. Cloud accounts and multi-user collaboration are explicitly out of scope until the local conflict model is proven.

title: Relay v1 specification
body: Included: one watched local folder, deterministic conflict copies, and manual pause. Deferred: cloud account sync, team collaboration, and phone clients.

title: commit f18d: incremental compiler
body: Added content-addressed annotation reuse. Unchanged entries now load from cache; only changed conversation windows are re-annotated.

title: Incremental compiler benchmark
body: On the frozen archive, a no-change rebuild fell from 11 hours to 26 minutes. The cache reused 94 percent of annotations and output record counts were unchanged.

title: Original telemetry decision
body: The February decision made anonymous crash telemetry opt-out by default to maximize diagnostic coverage.

title: Telemetry decision superseded
body: Supersede the February telemetry rule. After an enterprise proxy incident exposed unexpected outbound attempts, telemetry must be explicit opt-in from July 2026 onward.

title: commit 77aa: telemetry off by default
body: Changed the default to telemetry disabled. The setup flow now requires explicit opt-in and records the policy version and timestamp.

title: Nimbus issue 771
body: Nimbus v6.0.0 through v6.0.2 leak Windows file locks after cancelled writes. Upstream issue #771 marks the fix for v6.0.3.

title: commit 19cd: pin Nimbus
body: Pinned Nimbus below version 6 on Windows because leaked file locks broke cleanup and atomic replacement tests.

title: Nimbus upgrade condition
body: Upgrade only after Nimbus 6.0.3 is released and the Windows cancellation fixture passes 100 consecutive runs.

title: Staging deployment credential
body: The staging deploy used token sk-stage-private-example and stored it in the local credential manager under relay/staging.

title: Planning scratchpad
body: Possible future work includes weather imports, maps, and database research. No database selection or implementation decision was made.
